verdict.rationale: An internal API catalog or developer portal is a fair question for an API design and client tool, so the axis applies. The evidence shows only sharing collections and environments within organizations, Git Sync, and spec previews. These are adjacent collaboration features, not a published, discoverable catalog or portal that teams can browse to find and consume APIs.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, I can publish an internal catalog or portal where teams discover and consume our APIs
